name: instantdm-instagram
description: Manage Instagram from ChatGPT and Codex via InstantDM: publish posts, comments, DMs, insights, Meta ads, and the linked Facebook Page.

interface.shortDescription: Instagram DMs, comments, insights, and ads
interface.longDescription: InstantDM is a Meta Business Partner. This plugin lets ChatGPT and Codex manage an Instagram creator or business account through InstantDM's hosted MCP server: publish posts, reels, stories, and carousels; triage comments; reply publicly or by private DM; send DMs; pull account and post insights; and answer comments on Meta ads. Every send reaches a real person and costs 1 InstantDM credit — the bundled instagram-manager skill always shows the exact text and target for approval first.
defaultPrompt: Check my InstantDM connection, then triage today's Instagram comments and draft replies for me to approve.
Summarize unread Instagram DMs and draft replies in my voice.
Give me a 7-day Instagram performance report with top posts and 3 recommendations.
